probes.name: Exact duplicate identity and permuted serials
probes.oracle_rationale: Serials denote a set; same identity and same semantic payload count once.

probes.name: Conflicting duplicate identity before overlap
probes.oracle_rationale: Conflicting identity wins even with a separately overlapping lot.

probes.name: Nonparticipating identity conflict
probes.oracle_rationale: Neither OUT record intersects targets, so neither participates.

probes.name: Coverage cannot borrow a pending lot
probes.oracle_rationale: Pending target b does not repair absent accepted coverage.

probes.name: Single-day inclusive grant
probes.oracle_rationale: Both interval endpoints are inclusive.

probes.name: Future deny does not negate current grant
probes.oracle_rationale: Deny outside signature date scope has no effect.

probes.name: Same-day deny defeats grant
probes.oracle_rationale: Explicit scoped deny takes precedence.

probes.name: Unknown final does not contradict acceptance
probes.oracle_rationale: Unknown is not rejection.

probes.name: Replacing unknown by rejection changes result
probes.oracle_rationale: Older rejection still conflicts; no last-write-wins.

probes.name: Large preliminary report cannot cure shortfall
probes.oracle_rationale: Preliminary records never affect decision.

probes.name: Future rejection ignored at cutoff
probes.oracle_rationale: Future record has no authority at cutoff.

probes.name: Same rejection active one day later
probes.oracle_rationale: Changing cutoff includes adverse record.

probes.name: Revocation does not propagate to successor
probes.oracle_rationale: Revoking retired A leaves B live.

probes.name: Revoked successor never restores predecessor
probes.oracle_rationale: A remains retired and B is revoked.

probes.name: Self loop dominates live acceptance
probes.oracle_rationale: A self-loop is a directed cycle.

probes.name: Missing endpoint precedes self loop
probes.oracle_rationale: Endpoint check precedes cycle detection.

probes.name: Null release date is unknown
probes.oracle_rationale: Null date is insufficient release evidence.

probes.name: False release is not rejection
probes.oracle_rationale: Policy explicitly distinguishes false release from rejection.

probes.name: Invoice and review dates do not select regime
probes.oracle_rationale: Receipt date remains unchanged and selects NEW.

probes.name: Header cannot fill missing paragraph linkage

paragraphs.text: LINE: accepted 2 EA by RECEIVING_OFFICER; invoice unknown.

probes.oracle_rationale: Explicit source header does not establish paragraph linkage.

probes.name: Correct adjacent paragraph cannot rescue cited example

paragraphs.text: INV LINE: accepted 2 EA by RECEIVING_OFFICER.
INV LINE: accepted 2 EA by RECEIVING_OFFICER.

probes.oracle_rationale: Only cited assertion matters, not nearby positive text.

probes.name: Near identifier cannot rescue missing locator

paragraphs.text: INV LINE: accepted 2 EA by RECEIVING_OFFICER.

probes.oracle_rationale: Exact pair required, not similar-looking locator.

probes.name: Boolean invoice quantity
probes.oracle_rationale: Boolean is not positive integer input; desirable safety contract is nonclosure.

probes.name: Duplicate target serial identifiers
probes.oracle_rationale: Distinct-target precondition violated; avoid certifying malformed identity mapping.

probes.name: Contested acceptance status injected
probes.oracle_rationale: Positive uncontested acceptance assumption violated. Extra adverse field should trigger unsupported handling in a hardened boundary, not be counted as a policy defect.

probes.name: Conflicting payload for same event identity
probes.oracle_rationale: Same event ID describes two different events. Event-identity resolution is unspecified; nonclosure is a proposed structural safety requirement.

probes.name: Explicit acceptance mapping contradicts target
probes.oracle_rationale: Policy assumes target-line mapping; injected contradiction is outside domain.

probes.name: Release marked true with integer one
probes.oracle_rationale: Boolean schema excludes integer one. Nonclosure rather than truthiness coercion is desired.

probes.name: Structured accepted facts contradict prose

paragraphs.text: Invoice INV line LINE explicitly rejected, not accepted.

probes.oracle_rationale: Structured fields and prose are required to agree; no in-policy resolution rule exists. Test boundary detection, not natural-language policy accuracy.

probes.name: Conflicting repeated record identity
probes.oracle_rationale: Unique-record-ID assumption violated; nonclosure is conservative handling.

metamorphic_relations.why: Adding only nonparticipants preserves successful coverage.
Moving denial into scope changes result.
Unknown and rejection are not interchangeable.
Revoking predecessor versus successor is asymmetric.
Unknown date and false release both mean insufficient release evidence.
